title: Eat Like a Canadian Food Tour | Victoria Sightseeing
blurb:
Welcome to Canada, eh! Discover the stories and flavours that make Canadian cuisine unique on this delicious 2.5-hour walking tour through beautiful Victoria, BC.

Taste iconic Canadian favourites including poutine, Nanaimo bars, candied salmon, maple syrup treats, a Caesar cocktail, and more while learning about Indigenous food traditions and Canadian culinary history.

Along the way, explore some of Victoria's most famous sights including Fisherman's Wharf, the Inner Harbour, the Fairmont Empress Hotel, Government Street, and the Parliament Buildings.

Perfect for first-time visitors and international travelers, this small-group experience combines food, history, and sightseeing for the ultimate introduction to Canada and Victoria.

✔ Iconic Canadian dishes & local specialties
✔ Victoria landmarks & hidden gems
✔ Stories, history & culture
✔ Multiple tastings – enough for a meal
